relationships.subject: Demodex mites
relationships.evidence_quote: Increased Demodex mite population counts were associated with increased expression levels of TRPV1, tropomyosin receptor kinase A (TrkA) and nerve growth factor (NGF)

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: these levels could be reduced by capsazepine treatment in keratinocytes

key_findings: Demodex counts correlate with TRPV1, TrkA and NGF expression, reduced by capsazepine in keratinocytes
TRPV1-NGF-TrkA pathway proposed as a rosacea therapeutic target
